text: The one breaking change this week is #14002: External File Storage now rejects any path segment that is "." or "..", so callers that pass relative segments get an error instead of acting on a parent folder. Other behaviour changes start with Copilot. #14059 moves No. Series Copilot to GPT-5.6 Ceres. #14198 and #14307 do the same for Sales Lines Suggestions, with the prompts now shipped in the app. #14007 obsoletes Create Product Information with Copilot. Permission fixes landed in #14288 for report layout overrides by non-SUPER users and in #13679 for E-Document Core. Regional work includes SAF-T 1.40 for Norway in #13264, a Czech option to disable incremental exchange gain/loss posting in #13631, and GST fixes in #14008, #14009 and #13243. Fixes in other areas include direct transfers (#14020, #14147), Power BI deployment clearing (#14212, #14229), Job Queue cancellation (#14135), Dataverse endpoints (#14203), and the Word theme export extension (#12772). The Expense Agent gets corporate card selection in #13587 and several fixes. #13999 speeds up Intrastat XML export. Four inventory reports gain new Word layouts in #11205, and #9326 moves Finland's Depreciation Differences into a first-party extension.

issues: #14147 also corrected Quality Management demo data; only the direct transfer part is mentioned, which is acceptable.
#11205 also marks the existing Word layouts obsolete; not mentioned but not wrong.
Several behaviour-changing fixes (e.g. #14123 Shopify, #13820 NO SAF-T, #11660 FatturaPA) are omitted; acceptable for a summary of this length.
